name: create_appointment
description: MUST call immediately after the caller explicitly confirms one offered slot. Pass the exact caller_full_name from lookup_patient and copy practitioner_id, branch_id, appointment_type_id, and start_time unchanged from that exact search_availability slot. These five fields are sufficient; do not search availability again and do not ask for another confirmation. Never report a system error unless this tool was actually called and returned ok=false.

practitioner_id.description: Exact practitioner_id from the confirmed search_availability slot.

branch_id.description: Exact branch_id from the confirmed search_availability slot.

appointment_type_id.description: Exact appointment_type_id from the confirmed search_availability slot.
